faq.q: Are cups and gallons US or UK?
faq.a: Cups, pints and fluid ounces are US measures. Gallons come in both, labelled.

faq.q: What's the difference between GB and GiB?
faq.a: A gigabyte (GB) is 1,000,000,000 bytes, as used by drive makers. A gibibyte (GiB) is 1,073,741,824 bytes, which is what many operating systems show.
